input: A frame-wrapped MXF file the caller may read, and a frame of its index.
output: Where each frame's content package lies and which pictures are intra; the picture and sound elements of one frame as stored. None when the file carries no usable index (the caller reads as before). It never writes.
specification: User 2026-10-18: a filmstrip takes the intra picture nearest each of 13 places, read directly from the original by its own index (a camera's XAVC original keeps a full index after its header) instead of opening the file thirteen times; a coarse wave reads the sound of the intra frames only.
